Author: Ser Boogie
Name: Auto UI Fade
Punchline: Fades hotbars until they are needed.
Description: Fades selected native FFXIV hotbars, job gauges, parameter bars, and the experience bar to a configurable opacity while idle and restores them for hover, combat, weapon draw, crafting, gathering, PvP, duties, instances, NPC conversations, or a selected target.
